findings.title: Read content capabilities for reading page titles and content
findings.detail: Retrieving a page, retrieving page markdown and listing block children require the connection to have read content capabilities. Without that capability, the API returns 403. findings.title: Each customer decides which pages the app can read
findings.detail: The user chooses pages in the page picker, and the connection can access only pages the user selected and completed the flow for. The picker shows only pages the user has full access to. Each workspace member must complete the flow individually.
findings.appliesWhen: A customer wants the app to read pages in their workspace.

If the user clicks Allow access and the rest of the auth flow is not completed, the connection will not have access to the pages that were selected.
